options.text: Lead with the recommendation and the ask, then support it with focused data

options.rationale: Motion does not supply a decision.

items.stem: Which TWO keep linked Excel charts reliable in a live board presentation? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Verify and refresh links before presenting and keep the source available
options.rationale: Correct: refreshing and source availability prevent stale/broken visuals.

options.text: Have a static fallback image if the link cannot resolve
options.rationale: Correct: a fallback protects the live session.

options.text: Rely on auto-refresh with the source file deleted
options.rationale: A missing source breaks the link.

options.text: Paste a screenshot and claim it is live
options.rationale: A screenshot is not linked data.

items.explanation: Correct: refreshing and source availability prevent stale/broken visuals.

items.stem: A presenter wants to visually explain how an org structure transforms from current to proposed. Which feature best supports this?

options.text: The Morph transition between two arranged states
options.rationale: Correct: Morph animates the transformation to aid understanding.
Random transitions do not explain change.
Text alone does not show the transformation.
